text: What is normalization in databases, and why do we normalize tables?
expected: Organising tables to reduce redundancy and update/insert/delete anomalies; normal forms 1NF-3NF/BCNF; functional dependencies.

text: Explain the difference between a clustered and a non-clustered index.
expected: Clustered defines physical row order, one per table; non-clustered is a separate structure pointing to rows; B+ tree.

text: What do the ACID properties of a transaction mean?
expected: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability, each with a one-line meaning; logs/WAL for durability.

text: What is the difference between an inner join and a left outer join?
expected: Inner returns matching rows only; left returns all left rows with NULLs where no match.

text: When would you deliberately denormalize a schema, and what do you give up?
expected: Read-heavy workloads, avoiding joins, reporting; costs: redundancy, update anomalies, consistency maintenance.

text: Why can adding too many indexes slow a database down?
expected: Every write updates each index; storage; optimizer choices; maintenance; trade-off read vs write.

text: Explain the isolation levels, and what anomaly each one prevents.
expected: Read uncommitted, read committed, repeatable read, serializable; dirty read, non-repeatable read, phantom.

text: How does a database recover after a crash in the middle of a transaction?
expected: Write-ahead log, undo/redo, checkpoints, ARIES-style recovery.

text: Why might a query that uses an index still be slow?
expected: Low selectivity, functions on indexed column, wrong column order in composite index, stale statistics, random I/O.

text: An e-commerce site's order page takes eight seconds to load, and the slow query joins orders, customers and products. Walk me through how you would find and fix the problem.
expected: EXPLAIN plan, identify full scans, add/compose indexes on join keys, check N+1, limit columns, cache, measure again.

text: Two users book the last seat on a flight at the same moment and both get a confirmation. What went wrong, and how would you prevent it?
expected: Race condition / lost update; use transactions with proper isolation, SELECT FOR UPDATE, optimistic locking with version column, unique constraint.
